messages.author: a321e6ab7b0cca0d
messages.subject: Add a location (Part 2)
parts:
Hi all,
some days ago I asked how to add locations to a map [1] and got very
usefull answers. Thanks! But now I've changed the code a litte bit and
getting an error...

library(maptools)
library(ggplot2)
gpclibPermit()

myshp<- readShapeSpatial(system.file("shapes/sids.shp",
package="maptools"))

myshp.points<- fortify.SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(myshp,
region="CNTY_ID")

shpm<- merge(myshp.points, myshp, by.x="id", by.y="CNTY_ID")

p <- ggplot(shpm, aes(long, lat, group=group, fill=NWBIR74))
p <- p + geom_polygon() + geom_path(color="white") + coord_equal()
## ok, that's fine
p

## Some locations
cities <- read.table(textConnection("
long lat city
-78.644722 35.818889 Raleigh
-80.843333 35.226944 Charlotte
-82.555833 35.58 Asheville"), header = TRUE)

## Hmm, this won't run...
p <- p + geom_text(aes(group = NULL, lab = city),
data = cities, size = 3, color= 'white')
p

[1] http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/9f69ea14f1987f72/

Thanks for any suggestions,
Patrick

@Dennis: For no particular reason I chose "dodgerblue4" - I copied
and
pasted this from another example. Next time I'll use "balticseeblue"
so nobody gets upset ;-)

messages.author: 287d4059fae2f774
messages.subject: Re: Add a location (Part 2)
parts:
this should do it:
p <- p + geom_text(aes(fill = NULL,group=NULL, lab = city),
data = cities, size = 3, color= 'white')
einar

Hi Einar,
thank you very much - it works perfect!

But now I'm having another question: I would like to add borders from
a higher administrial level to a map. Right now I have a "basic map"
p and in p2 are the borders I'm trying to add.

library(maptools)
library(ggplot2)
gpclibPermit()

myshp<- readShapeSpatial(system.file("shapes/sids.shp",
package="maptools"))
myshp.points <- fortify.SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(myshp,
region="CNTY_ID")
shpm<- merge(myshp.points, myshp, by.x="id", by.y="CNTY_ID")
p <- ggplot(shpm, aes(long, lat, group=group, fill=BIR74))
p <- p + geom_polygon() + geom_path(color="white") + coord_equal()

p

## Aggregate the CNTY_ID to use a higher administrial level
myshp@data$CNTY_ID2 = substr(myshp@data$CNTY_ID, 1, 3)
myshp2.points <- fortify.SpatialPolygonsDataFrame(myshp,
region="CNTY_ID2")
shpm2<- merge(myshp2.points, myshp, by.x="id", by.y="CNTY_ID2")

p2 <- ggplot(shpm2, aes(x = long, y = lat, group = group))
p2 <- p2 + geom_path(size=1) + coord_equal()
p2

Any ideas how to merge/join/overlay the two maps?...

Thanks for any suggestions,
Patrick

messages.subject: Re: Add a location (Part 2)
parts:
Patrick-

is this not what you're looking for?

p + geom_path(data=shpm2, size=1)

just layers (e.g. section 4.3 of hadleys book), you're already layering geoms in p. just adding another in this. but maybe I misunderstand what you're trying to do.

I have a question about his earlier question, I did not expect the aesthetics to need to be "nulled" as required. I thought specifying an aesthetic in a geom() didnt imply inheritance of aesthetic from ggplot(). (again, i'm probably wrong)

best, 

James
